healthy_requires: 100% active claims have at least one registered source

claim_types.observed: Directly reported by a named source or dataset.
claim_types.proposed: Possible intervention or action, not a statement of reality.

capability_levels.name: Observe
capability_levels.description: Display sourced facts and raw public signals.

capability_levels.name: Propose
capability_levels.description: Surface possible actions with evidence and constraints.

capability_levels.name: Prepare / hand off
capability_levels.description: Prepare or open an external action path while the user retains execution authority.

capability_levels.name: Execute reversible
capability_levels.description: Execute low-risk reversible actions through authorized integrations.

capability_levels.name: Execute consequential
capability_levels.description: Execute consequential actions only under explicit organizational governance and human authorization.

claims.statement: Flash floods struck northern Nepal on 26 Aug 2026.
claims.limitations: Event date is reported by IFRC.

claims.statement: IFRC estimated that around 93,000 people may have been affected while assessments were continuing.
claims.limitations: Early estimate; not presented as a final affected-population count.

claims.statement: IFRC launched a CHF 25 million Emergency Appeal.
claims.limitations: Appeal amount does not indicate current funding percentage.

claims.statement: IFRC reported safe drinking water restored for around 2,000 people in Nuwakot.
claims.limitations: Response outcome; no causal attribution to an individual contribution.

claims.statement: IFRC reported a mobile primary-health clinic capable of reaching 100 patients per day.
claims.limitations: Capacity is not the same as patients actually treated.

claims.statement: IFRC provides a Nepal-specific public donation path for the 2026 flash-flood response.
claims.limitations: Availability of the external page does not prove a user completed a donation.

claims.statement: WHO validated Bhutan for eliminating dog-transmitted human rabies as a public-health problem.
claims.limitations: Validated elimination status must be sustained through ongoing prevention.

claims.statement: WHO reported zero human deaths from dog-mediated rabies in Bhutan since June 2023.
claims.limitations: Zero human deaths does not mean zero dog bites or zero animal rabies risk.

claims.statement: Bhutan continues post-exposure prophylaxis, dog vaccination, population management and surveillance to sustain elimination.
claims.limitations: Programme details can change over time.

claims.statement: WHO reported 7,475 confirmed cases in DRC as of 16 Sep 2026.
WHO reported 3,605 confirmed deaths in DRC as of 16 Sep 2026.
WHO reported 1,798 recoveries in DRC as of 16 Sep 2026.
claims.limitations: Recoveries do not imply that the epidemic is improving overall.

claims.statement: WHO reported encouraging signs in some areas while stating that the epidemic continued to grow overall.
claims.limitations: Regional improvements and national deterioration can coexist.

claims.statement: COMMONS has not verified a direct public intervention tightly enough to surface one for this story.
claims.limitations: This is a product safety decision, not a claim that no legitimate intervention exists.

incidents.title: CSS parse error exposed inactive interface layers
incidents.impact: Inactive story, evidence and explorer layers could render together, reducing clarity and trust in the interface.
incidents.root_cause: An unmatched CSS brace caused later style rules to parse incorrectly.
incidents.correction: Fixed the malformed rule, added early critical containment rules and added CSS brace-balance regression tests.
incidents.prevention: Inactive application layers now have early visibility containment and CI checks CSS brace balance.

evaluation_requirements.label: Every active claim has registered provenance
No active critical claim is stale
Every referenced source exists and declares limitations
Every claim is explicitly observed, derived, inferred or proposed
Action receipts never imply outcome causality
External action completion is never silently treated as verified
A story may explicitly expose no verified public action
Trust registry failure produces a degraded state

correction_policy.description: Material claim corrections should preserve the previous state, timestamp the change and explain why it changed.
